title: Agent Outcome Test for Agent-Facing Artifact Admissibility
summary: A Tier-2 felt-trigger at agent-facing artifact creation, parallel to ADR-083's human-facing Outcome Test: does this artifact produce direct agent consumption without re-orientation cost, or does it feel additional to the agent-facing corpus?

links.note: Tier-2 application; graduation trigger names a candidate /rdd-conform audit step
both inherit the discriminating-criterion limit: a trivially-passing answer (naming any consumer) satisfies the letter of the test
